question_text: Was the DoorDash outage on Nov 21 a cyberattack?
answer_text: Not established. DoorDash blames a database connectivity issue on an internal address service and has not mentioned an attack, but it has not said either way. No one has shown evidence of a hack.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: A DoorDash statement saying whether an attack was involved, or a finding from a regulator or an outside investigator.

answer_text: DoorDash says a database connectivity issue on an internal address service caused errors across its services from about 10:55 to 11:45 AM ET. It has not said what made the connection fail.
label: Confirmed
what_would_settle_it: Answered by DoorDash's post-incident note. The Drive incident's post mortem would show whether it had the same cause.

question_text: Did the DoorDash app and website go down on Nov 21, and for how long?
answer_text: Yes, per reports. Users saw errors from about 11 AM ET. DoorDash says errors across its services ran from about 10:55 to 11:45 AM ET, and it closed the Drive incident at 1:58 PM ET. It has not said when the app was back for everyone.
label: Reported

question_text: Is the Drive incident the same as the app and website outage?
what_would_settle_it: DoorDash saying which incident affected the app and website.

question_text: How many DoorDash customers were affected?
what_would_settle_it: DoorDash giving a figure. Downdetector counts reports, not users.
